title: Derived stalk pullback as scalar extension with counit computation
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], with chosen derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix $z\in X'$ and the actual stalk rings $R,A,B,C$ and their algebra maps from [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. There exist a functor $L:D(A)\to D(C)$, a universal left-derived counit $\epsilon$ for ordinary extension along $A\to A\otimes_R B\to C$, and a natural isomorphism $j:(-)_{g'z}\circ L\cong L(g')^*\circ(-)_z$ (composition written in application order), where exact derived stalks are those of [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. For every K-flat sheaf complex $P$ with invertible recorded pullback counit, the scalar-extension counit is invertible at $P_{g'z}$. For every $i\in\mathbf Z$, if $s_P:H^i(L(Q(P_{g'z})))\cong H^i(P_{g'z}\otimes_A C)$ is its counit homology identification including localization factors, and $k_P=L$ applied to the inverse exact-stalk localization factor followed by $j_{Q(P)}$, then $s_P^{-1};H^i(k_P)$ equals homology of the specified tensorStalkIso, followed by the inverse comparisonStalkHomologyIso and derived-stalk cohomology of the inverse sheaf pullback counit. The statement contains no base-derived model comparison or source cohomology transport.

proof.text: Use exists_baseDerivedExtension_linear with the algebra structure induced by the composite actual stalk map to obtain L, ε and their universal property.
Obtain j and its equation of derived-category morphisms from the intermediate comparison theorem. The K-flat stalk criterion and scalarExtensionCounit_isIso_of_kFlat give hsP independently.

Apply homology to the derived-category equation. The proved private homology_comparison cancels the scalar-extension identification, uses naturality of homologyFunctorFactors.inv, and expresses the result using comparisonStalkHomologyIso.
